mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, u.display_name requester_name, a.display_name assignee_name FROM tickets t JOIN users u ON u.id=t.requester_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id=t.assignee_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT u.id,u.display_name,r.code role FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE u.enabled=1 AND r.code IN ('COORDINATOR','SUPPORT')
mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE u.enabled=1 AND r.code='COORDINATOR'
SELECT e.*,u.display_name actor_name FROM ticket_events e JOIN users u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.ticket_id=#{ticketId} ORDER BY e.created_at,e.id
SELECT code,name FROM permissions ORDER BY id
SELECT code,name FROM permissions WHERE code=#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_permission(ticket_id,user_id,permission_code,permission_name,status) SELECT #{ticketId},#{userId},code,name,'PENDING' FROM permissions WHERE code=#{permissionCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_permission SET status=#{status},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy},reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), permission_code=COALESCE(#{permissionCode},permission_code), permission_name=COALESCE((SELECT p.name FROM permissions p WHERE p.code=#{permissionCode}),permission_name) WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND status='PENDING'
